description: Public evaluation fixtures for local AI tagging and categorization: 640 px thumbnails of Wikimedia Commons files, each under its own free licence. Images are downloaded on demand and verified by SHA-256; none are stored in the repository. Labels were assigned by visual review on 2026-10-12. 'labels' must be found (alternatives separated by '|'); 'acceptable' may be emitted; any other vocabulary label counts as a false positive. 'category' is the expected folder (null: no category is expected) and 'acceptable_categories' are not errors.
